requirements_summary: Index scale: ~20M SKUs across multiple storefronts, need sharding strategy and warm-up behavior
Vector store: ANN with fine-grained control, prefer HNSW/IVF options and ability to host in-VPC
Embeddings: precompute for catalog; need embedding dim ~1536 or lower for cost; experimentation with 512->1024 dims desired
Reranking: online re-ranker for top-50 candidates using a small LM (2-6B) or distilled pairwise model
Latency targets: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 110ms, p99 < 200ms for combined search+rerank (target is p99 < 120ms if possible)
Cost targets: blended cost per query < $0.003 at baseline; acceptable tradeoffs if peak auto-fallback lowers cost but keeps relevance
Seasonal traffic: baseline 1M queries/day, Black Friday peaks up to 5x; autoscaling + graceful degradation policies required
Data controls: per-tenant data residency for EU customers, audit logs, key management via customer KMS
poc_scope: 6-week pilot: index 500k SKUs initially, measure end-to-end latency and cost per query
Objectives: establish p99 latency, per-query cost, and quality delta vs current Elastic baseline (NDCG@10)
Success metrics: cost/query <= $0.004 in POC, relative NDCG uplift >= 8%, p99 latency <= 150ms at 2x baseline traffic
Deliverables: performance report, quantization recommendations, autoscaling runbook, failover policy for peak periods
notes: Buyer: VP Product (Elena Rivers) — cost-conscious, wants clear unit economics before committing.
Quote from Elena: 'We can tolerate a tiny drop in precision if it buys reliability and predictable cost during peak runs.'
Engineering lead: Nate Huang — cares about reproducible re-ranking and ability to A/B model variants in rollout.
SE ask: show token-level cost breakdown + per-route telemetry (tokens vs ANN ops vs reranker GPU time).
Infosec: primary ask is KMS integration and proof that KV caches don't leak across tenants.
Current stack: Elastic + homegrown heuristic reranker; experimenting with vector layer (testing Pinecone for similarity).
POC constraints: must be deployable into their AWS VPC for data residency; limited to eu-west-1 for EU storefronts.
Potential upsell: Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput during seasonal peaks, Optimize for automated batching and quant recommendations.
